source.description: Approved eight-panel handmade felt-tip-marker raster contact sheet cropped into JPG masters.
source.notes: Replace only the preflight-rejected roller-skate candidate; this face-free magical hat has a separate silhouette and drawing problem.

process_strategy: One floppy wizard hat grows from a brim and cone construction, then gets a crescent buckle, three stars, marker outline, saturated fill, and limited finishing accents without changing the established shape.

final_elements.name: construction guides
final_elements.description: Pale brim ellipse, cone axis, bend gesture, band footprint, star centers, and shadow footprint.

final_elements.name: floppy wizard hat silhouette
final_elements.description: One tall bent purple cone and wide oval brim with a tipped point.

final_elements.name: buckle band
final_elements.description: One orange band and one crescent-moon buckle crossing the lower cone.

final_elements.name: three star accents
final_elements.description: Exactly three five-point stars arranged around the cone.

final_elements.name: marker color and shadow
final_elements.description: Purple, orange, yellow, teal, and navy marker fills with one flat broken navy shadow.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: Cone texture and color stop under the full band route.

frames.visible_job: Place one wide brim ellipse, tall bent cone route, band footprint, three star centers, and a flat shadow reserve in pale pencil.
Connect the brim and cone into one tall tipped wizard-hat silhouette while keeping later reserves open.
Draw the established band and one crescent buckle across the cone.
Turn the three centers into exactly three five-point stars and add brim seams and a few fold lines.
Trace only established contours and details with thick imperfect black felt-tip, including the established flat broken shadow.

final_step.visible_job: Only clarifies established outline, marker fill, paper shines, and shadow.

rejection_checks: Reject a hat that changes bend, brim, buckle, or three-star count between frames.
Reject final-only stars, band, color, shine, or shadow.
Reject vector-clean icon art or glossy poster rendering; retain felt-tip texture and imperfect black outlines.
